sources: https://fbref.com/ (player season + scouting per-90 tables; read via search snippets, WebFetch 403)
https://understat.com/ (xG/xA shot models for big-5 leagues)
https://www.fotmob.com/ (Opta per-90, xA, shots, key passes)
method: Club-season 2025-26 per-90 attacking output. Goals/assists/minutes and many xG/shots/key-pass per-90s are search-confirmed from FBref/Opta/Understat mirror aggregators; remaining per-90s (flagged with 'est' in each player's notes) are calibrated estimates from the player's role/league. xg_p90 is non-penalty xG/90 where available; sot_p90 is shots-on-target/90 (shots/90 where SoT not surfaced, noted); key_passes_p90 approximates key passes / shot-creating actions per 90. These are a WITHIN-TEAM goal/assist distribution signal, not cross-league-comparable absolute rates — players in MLS / Saudi / Brazil / Liga MX / Eredivisie / Super Lig are flagged as weaker-league in notes and should be discounted.

notes: Covered 24 teams, 205 fantasy-relevant players. Per team: key attackers, attacking mids, set-piece takers, premium/attacking defenders, and the first-choice GK (GK rows carry zero attacking output, present only so the feed can match the nailed #1). Confirmed PENALTY takers flagged via pens=true (Oyarzabal, Mbappe, Messi, Kane, Bruno Fernandes, Haaland, De Bruyne, Modric, Pulisic, Raul Jimenez, Valverde, Brahim Diaz, James Rodriguez, Son, Ueda, Sadio Mane, Enner Valencia, Granit Xhaka, Arnautovic, Memphis Depay, Julian Alvarez). LEAGUE-STRENGTH CAVEAT: MLS (Messi, Son, James, Berhalter, De Paul), Saudi (Ronaldo, Sadio Mane, Darwin Nunez, Theo Hernandez, Koulibaly), Brazil league (Neymar, De Arrascaeta, Enner Valencia, Plata), Liga MX (Alexis Vega), Eredivisie/Super Lig/other (Ueda, Pepi, Leroy Sane) numbers are NOT comparable to big-5 rates. KEY DATA CAVEATS: Lukaku ~40 min all season (thigh, bench risk); Havertz only 583 min (injury, tiny sample); Musiala returning from broken ankle Jan'26; Yamal hamstring (MD1 minutes risk); Santiago Gimenez ice-cold (0 league goals vs ~0.55 xG/90); Nico Williams pubalgia. James Rodriguez per-90 is LOW confidence (club moves, MLS). Germany pen duty is FLUID (Kimmich took last competitive pen Oct'25; Havertz widely expected) - left pens=false on both to avoid double-counting. NOT covered (weaker qualifiers / not deep-run contenders per brief): South Africa, Cape Verde, Saudi Arabia, Paraguay, Australia, Turkey, Algeria, Jordan, Curacao, Ivory Coast, Haiti, Scotland, Panama, Ghana, Egypt, Iran, NZ, Qatar, Uzbekistan, DR Congo, Iraq, Sweden, Tunisia, Bosnia, Czechia, Canada. Denmark & Italy did NOT qualify (skipped per brief). Names use widely-recognized knownName/surname forms to match the FIFA fantasy feed by nation+surname; nation keys are canonical English (USA, Mexico, South Korea).
